sdc.daemon.RouteSource.title: RouteSource
sdc.daemon.RouteSource.description: The setting that chose a run's route: run (the submit named it, `model_route` or `model_routes.<role>`) or default (the submit named none and the daemon's `route_policy.default` applied; a daemon whose file declares no route but a lone `[gateway]` table gives a model run the route `default` on that gateway, as before routes, and says default too). The protocol's own word comes with its story.
